up: Find all molecules reported in document CHEMBL4118110. Return the following columns: molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), pref_name (from molecule_dictionary), max_phase (from molecule_dictionary), molecule_type (from molecule_dictionary), and canonical_smiles (from compound_structures). Join activities to docs to filter by the specific chembl_id 'CHEMBL4118110'. Then join molecule_dictionary and compound_structures using molregno. Sort the results by molecule_chembl_id in ascending order. Do not apply any limits on the number of rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN activities a ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4118110' ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id ASC
